Risk description: Biased or unrepresentative training data (e.g. few rural or thin-file customers) causes unequal error rates.
Control (existing or proposed): Data representativeness audit; documented data sheet; add under-represented segments.

Risk description: Proxy discrimination: behaviour features (cash use, night activity, account age) stand in for region or income.
Control (existing or proposed): Proxy correlation tests; peer-group normalisation; fairness thresholds as a release gate.

Risk description: False positives freeze or reject legitimate customers, e.g. traders whose cash flow is seasonal or who run savings groups (ajo, esusu, adashe).
Control (existing or proposed): Human review before any block; step-up checks instead of freezes; rules tuned for informal-economy patterns; 24-hour appeal.

Risk description: Automation bias: reviewers rubber-stamp scores; overrides are not recorded or trusted.
Control (existing or proposed): Reviewer training; mandatory evidence check; override logging; sampling audit of approvals.

Risk description: Breach or misuse of identity documents, face images, transaction data and any phone data collected (including contacts of people who never agreed).
Control (existing or proposed): Encryption; least privilege; minimisation and retention limits; DPIA; breach playbook.

Risk description: Solely automated adverse decisions without a lawful basis or human intervention (NDPA s.37).
Control (existing or proposed): Human-in-the-loop for adverse outcomes; notices; documented lawful basis; intervention route.

Risk description: Face verification makes more errors for some skin tones, genders or ages, locking people out at onboarding.
Control (existing or proposed): Test error rates by skin tone, gender and age before launch; offer a non-biometric fallback route; require vendor test evidence.

Risk description: Opaque scores that staff cannot explain and customers cannot challenge.
Control (existing or proposed): Reason codes per decision; model card; plain-language adverse-action notice.

Risk description: Model drift as fraud patterns and customer behaviour change, silently degrading accuracy and fairness.
Control (existing or proposed): Monthly drift and fairness monitoring; retrain triggers; rollback plan.

Risk description: Third-party or cloud processing and cross-border transfer without adequate safeguards.
Control (existing or proposed): Vendor due diligence; data processing agreements; transfer mechanism check (NDPA Part VIII).

Risk description: Adversarial fraudsters probe and evade the model, or poison its feedback data.
Control (existing or proposed): Rate limiting; red-team testing; feedback-data validation; layered rules plus model.

Risk description: Slow or unclear incident escalation when harm or a fairness breach is detected.
Control (existing or proposed): Severity matrix; named escalation path to AI Governance Committee; kill-switch authority.
